scope: read-only performance and health audit; no configuration or application changes

request_log_sample.window: last 30 minutes, application tail capped at 18000 lines
request_log_sample.note: WebSocket durations describe connection lifetimes, not page response latency.

websocket.reason: Two actual public client addresses matched their full Redis IP-capacity groups; not reverse proxy address misclassification.

network_probe.note: A probe from the work environment is not representative of all player networks.

diagnostic_impact.description: An additional Django diagnostic process executed inside the 384 MiB Web container triggered cgroup OOM; kernel killed Daphne and Docker automatically restarted Web once. This occurred during the audit, after initial restart count was zero.
diagnostic_impact.recovery: Web healthy, all readiness checks passed; subsequent probes used lightweight CLI and host HTTP instead of Django setup.

recommended_priorities: Improve websocket page lifecycle release and reconnect behavior under IP capacity pressure; retain Origin validation.
Compress the two approximately 3 MB ring images for web delivery.
Raise Web memory headroom, for example 384 MiB to 768 MiB, in a separately authorized configuration update.
limitations: Player-specific page and incident time have not been provided.
The confirmed WebSocket quota exhaustion explains realtime channel failures; it does not establish the cause of every reported page slowdown.
